title: Completed local ring of A[x] is formally smooth over A for its adic topology
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $A[x]$ the polynomial ring in one variable [def-weil-polynomial-ring], $\mathfrak q\subset A[x]$ a prime ideal, $T=A[x]_{\mathfrak q}$ the localization at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak qT$, and $C=T^\wedge=\varprojlim_nT/\mathfrak q^nT$ its $\mathfrak qT$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], an $A$-algebra via $A\to A[x]\to T\to C$. Then $C$ is formally smooth over $A$ for the $\mathfrak qC$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic].

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07PU (lemma-another-helper-G-ring, line 12494), sentence 'As A -> A[x]_q^ is formally smooth (see Lemmas 07EC and 07ED)'; Lemma Tag 07EC (lemma-formally-smooth, line 9165) part (1), Lemma Tag 07ED (lemma-formally-smooth-completion, line 9224) (1) => (2); A -> A[x] formally smooth (polynomial algebra) and A[x] -> A[x]_q formally smooth (localization) in the sense of Algebra, Definition 00TI
